description: List per-team match contributions across many FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) matches. Each row is one team's involvement in one match (alliance, pre-match EPA, predicted contribution, outcome). Filter by `team` (one team's entire match log), `year`, `event`, `week` (0-8), `match` (a single match key - returns one row per team in that match), and `elim` (true for elimination matches only). Sort with `metric`/`ascending` and paginate with `limit`/`offset`. Use this to build a scouting timeline ("every match team 254 played in 2024 with their EPA contribution"), compare alliance partners, or compute per-team averages over a range of matches.

ascending.description: Whether to sort in ascending order. Default is ascending.

elim.description: Whether the match is an elimination match.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-1000). Default is 1000.

metric.description: How to sort the returned values. Any column in the table is valid.

offset.description: Offset from the first result to return.

week.description: Week of the competition season. 8 is CMP.

name: get_team_matches
